name: Exp_XRVI
summary: This EA trades based on the XRVI (Refined Volume Index) custom indicator, generating buy signals when the XRVI main line crosses above its signal line and sell signals on the reverse crossover. It uses advanced smoothing algorithms (JJMA, JurX, etc.) for both the indicator and signal line calculations, with configurable money management and position permissions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义XRVI指标进行交易，当主线穿越信号线向上时产生买入信号，向下穿越时产生卖出信号。它使用高级平滑算法（JJMA、JurX等）计算指标线和信号线，并支持可配置的资金管理和持仓权限控制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XRVI指标的主线与信号线交叉进行动量交易。入场条件为：当主线从下方穿越信号线向上时开多仓，当主线从上方穿越信号线向下时开空仓。出场条件包括：止损和止盈分别基于点数设置（默认1000点和2000点），同时当反向信号出现时也会平仓（多仓在卖出信号时平仓，空仓在买入信号时平仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。信号检测仅在新的K线形成时执行（通过IsNewBar类），避免重复计算和频繁交易。EA支持独立控制买入开仓、卖出开仓、多仓平仓和空仓平仓的权限，提供了灵活的交易控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is momentum trading based on the crossover of the XRVI indicator's main line and signal line. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the main line crosses above the signal line (with the previous bar showing the main line was below or equal to the signal line), and a sell position opens on the reverse crossover. Exit conditions include fixed Stop Loss (default 1000 points) and Take Profit (default 2000 points), plus reverse signal closure where long positions close on sell signals and short positions close on buy signals. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Signal detection only executes on new bar formations using the CIsNewBar class, preventing redundant calculations and overtrading. The EA provides granular permission controls for buy/sell opening and closing independently.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，负值为固定手数，正值为存款比例
parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lot; negative value = lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格滑点偏差点数

parameters.name: RviPhase
parameters.description: 第一次平滑参数，JJMA范围-100到+100
parameters.description_en: First smoothing parameter, JJMA range -100 to +100

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 用于指标计算的价格类型

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用高级平滑算法（JurX、JJMA等），减少指标滞后和虚假信号
独立的买卖开平仓权限控制，灵活性高
新K线检测机制避免同根K线内重复交易
支持多种价格类型和自定义时间周期，适应性强
包含止损止盈设置，具备基本风险管理框架
pros_en: Uses advanced smoothing algorithms (JurX, JJMA etc.) reducing indicator lag and false signals
Independent buy/sell open/close permission controls provide high flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar
Supports multiple price types and custom timeframes for strong adaptability
Includes Stop Loss and Take Profit settings with a basic risk management framework
cons: 缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
依赖自定义指标文件（XRVI和SmoothAlgorithms.mqh），缺乏内嵌容错
止损止盈仅支持固定点数，不支持动态或ATR-based止损
没有最大持仓数量限制或日亏损限制
cons_en: Lacks spread filter, potentially leading to unfavorable entries in high-spread environments
No position check logic, may open duplicate positions in the same direction
Depends on external custom indicator files (XRVI and SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) without fallback
Stop Loss and Take Profit only support fixed points, no dynamic or ATR-based alternatives
No maximum position count limit or daily drawdown limit
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，避免在点差过大时入场
添加持仓检查逻辑，防止同方向重复开仓，并支持最大持仓数量限制
引入ATR动态止损止盈替代固定点数，提高适应性
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to avoid entering when spreads are excessively wide
Add position check logic to prevent duplicate same-direction entries and support maximum position limits
Introduce ATR-based dynamic Stop Loss/Take Profit instead of fixed points for better adaptability

risk_points: 没有持仓检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致过度持仓
固定止损止盈在不同波动率环境下可能不适用
依赖外部指标文件，若文件缺失会导致EA无法正常运行
risk_points_en: No position check may cause duplicate same-direction entries leading to overexposure
Fixed Stop Loss/Take Profit may be inappropriate under varying volatility conditions
Dependency on external indicator files; missing files will cause EA failure
